verdict.rationale: The pricing page says compute is billed by the second at about $0.000004167 per GiB-second, with no one-hour compute minimum, and that paused sandboxes incur storage charges only. The sandbox docs separately confirm that paused sandboxes incur no compute charges on Sandbox0 Cloud, and pause/resume lets compute stop between tasks. Missing for 10: clarity on whether billing tracks actual resource use or allocated template resources (and how CPU is metered), and independent or hands-on corroboration of billing behavior.
